title: Beet and Russian Cream Soup
description: A creamy and earthy soup made with beets and Russian-style ingredients.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the beets and cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Stir in the creamy russian sauce and heavy cream.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
